header.title: Tooltip
header.description: Floating explanation that appears on hover or focus. It renders in a portal (on the body or the closest <dialog>) and repositions itself to stay on screen.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Tweak the props and hover or focus the button to see the result.

base.title: Base
base.description: Wrap a single element with Tooltip and pass the text in `content`. It opens on hover or focus.

placements.title: Placements
placements.description: `placement` sets the preferred side: top, bottom, left or right. If it doesn't fit, it shifts to stay visible.

onIconButton.title: On icon button
onIconButton.description: An icon-only button needs `aria-label`; the tooltip adds the visible description. The example uses the gem-system `.gem-field-info` class for the button.

longContent.title: Long content
longContent.description: Long text wraps with a max width of 18rem. Still, keep it brief.

texts.content: Tooltips can wrap longer helper copy. Keep it short when possible so the message stays easy to scan.
texts.label: Long tip

instant.title: Instant
instant.description: `delay={0}` opens it with no wait. The default is 200 ms.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `disabled` turns the tooltip off without touching the element. An empty `content` doesn't show either.

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: With `open` and `onOpenChange` you drive it from your state. Hover, focus and Escape still call `onOpenChange`.

tailwind.brandContent: Primary background and radius lg with cn() on className
tailwind.mergedContent: rounded-full and secondary replace the base values

css.richBody: Title and body inside the same tooltip.
css.inlineContent: One-off tweak with the style prop

header.title: Tooltip API
header.description: API reference for the Tooltip React component: props, CSS classes, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demo page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath to load only this component.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Tooltip accepts no native attributes. It clones its single child and adds ref, aria-describedby and the onMouseEnter, onMouseLeave, onFocus, onBlur and onKeyDown handlers, keeping the ones it already has. className and style go to the bubble; wrapperClassName goes to the <span> that wraps the child.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.role: The bubble has role="tooltip" and a unique id.
a11y.describedBy: While open, the child gets aria-describedby pointing to the bubble.
a11y.triggers: It opens on hover and on focus, so it also works with the keyboard.
a11y.focusable: The child must be able to receive focus and mouse events. A disabled button doesn't fire them: wrap it in a <span tabIndex={0}>.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles. The bubble lives in a portal, so style it through `className`, not from the trigger container.

rules.root: Tooltip bubble (position: fixed). Receives `className` and style.
rules.arrow: Arrow. Inherits the bubble background color.
rules.ready: Applied once positioned; sets the opacity to 1.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Tooltip defines no variables of its own: it uses gem-system tokens. Since it lives in a portal, redefine them in `className` or globally.

items.--gem-palette-neutral-900: Bubble and arrow background (neutral-100 in dark mode).

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: It accepts no native attributes: the trigger is the child you pass.

items.children: Single element that triggers the tooltip. It must accept a ref and events.
items.placement: Preferred side relative to the trigger.
items.delay: Wait before opening on hover or focus (ms).
items.offset: Distance between the trigger and the bubble (px).
items.onOpenChange: Fires when the open state changes.
